headline: EasyJet Warns High Jet Fuel Prices Threaten Airline Solvency
summary: Soaring fuel costs could push more airlines toward bankruptcy, according to EasyJet's CEO, despite the carrier hedging 69% of its fuel contracts in advance.
why: Jet fuel represents a major operating expense for airlines, making fuel price volatility a critical determinant of carrier profitability and survival.

impacts.name: EasyJet
impacts.why: Elevated jet fuel prices increase operating costs and threaten margins across the airline sector.
